 Coram: Honourable Mr. Justice Nawneet Kumar Pandey

Heard learned counsel for the appellant as well as learned Spl.P.P. assisted by the learned counsel for the informant.
This appeal has been preferred on behalf of the appellant under Section 14-A(2) of the Scheduled Castes and Scheduled Tribes (Prevention of Atrocities) Act for setting aside the order dated 18.11.2022, passed by the learned I st Additional Sessions Judge-cum-Special Judge Schedule Caste/
Schedule Tribe Act, Bhojpur at Ara in B.P. No. 6921 of 2022 arising out of S.C./S.T.(K) P.S. Case No.
32 of 2022, registered for the offences punishable under Sections 341/323/384/379/504/506/34 of the Indian Penal Code, 27 Arms Act and 3(i)(r)(s)/3(2)(Va) S.C./S.T. P.O.A. Act, whereby the prayer for bail of the appellant has been rejected.
The specific allegation against the appellant is that he open fired with intention to kill the informant but he was saved.

Learned counsel for the appellant has submitted that Patna High Court CR. APP (SJ) No.4308 of 2022(3) dt.22-03-2023 there is election rivalry between the informant and the appellant as the informant is present Mukhiya and the appellant was former Mukhiya.

It was the reason that he has Jitendra Singh Yadav @ Jitendra Yadav @ ... vs The State Of Bihar on 22 March, 2023 Indian Kanoon - http://indiankanoon.org/doc/51314585/
1 falsely been implicated.

entities.label: PRECEDENT

sentences.text: He has also submitted that the driver of the appellant is also accused in this case and his mother has lodged a case against the informant for the offences under section 376 and other allied sections of the IPC.
The appellant is under custody since 02.11.2022.
On the other hand, the learned counsel for the informant has opposed the prayer for bail and has submitted that a number of cases are pending against the appellant.
He is a person of criminal antecedents.

Considering the nature of allegation as well as the period of incarceration, the appellant,
above-named, shall be released on bail on furnishing bail bond of Rs. 10,000/- (Ten Thousand) each with two sureties of the like amount each to the satisfaction of learned I st Additional Sessions Judge-cum-Special Judge Schedule Caste/ Schedule Tribe Act, Bhojpur at Ara in connection with S.C./S.T.(K) P.S. Case No. 32 of 2022.

(Nawneet Kumar Pandey, J) SONALI/-
